title: Embed clinical safety accountability in governance and decision support
requirements:
- State that only suitable recommendations are made computable and that clinical judgement remains
- Include clinical, clinical-informatics and patient-safety expertise in governance bodies for care-affecting decisions
- Add severity classification and patient-safety escalation for semantic errors across the lifecycle
- Add a structured clinical-risk methodology (e.g. hazard log) as a governance consideration
- Distinguish deterministic rules, statistical models and AI, with assurance proportionate to type and risk
- Name an accountable clinical-governance or patient-safety authority among strategic responsibilities
- Define urgent-change authority, minimum review, rollback and post-hoc review
- Address explainability, alert fatigue, automation bias, testing beyond unit tests and proportionate override capture
